2609.05139.title: NS-ST-GraphRAG: Neuro-Symbolic Spatio-Temporal GraphRAG for Literary Knowledge Processing
2609.05139.paper_summary: Long-form literary narratives pose a distinctive information-processing challenge for retrieval-augmented generation: relevant evidence is distributed across chapters, relations evolve over narrative time, and correct answers may depend jointly on temporal, spatial, and relational constraints. We propose NS-ST-GraphRAG, a neuro-symbolic spatio-temporal GraphRAG framework that integrates ontology-guided extraction, deterministic constraint checking, dual temporal coordinates, spatial scene attributes, and dynamic sub-graph retrieval. Instead of retrieving from a single corpus-level graph, the framework selects the graph state valid for the temporal and spatial scope of a query and grounds generated answers in traceable evidence. We further introduce Red-Chamber-QA, to our knowledge the first open multi-hop question-answering benchmark for classical Chinese literature, with time-, space-, and general-question categories, per-part evidence spans, and deterministic shortcut controls. On a 120-question held-out split, NS-ST-GraphRAG achieves mechanical answer reproduction of 0.733 versus 0.675 for the frozen window baseline and 0.083 for a closed-book model (McNemar exact p = 0.092, directionally favorable but not significant); semantic-judge accuracy is 0.866 versus 0.850. The pre-specified constrained-category condition of H2 is not supported by the delivered comparison. These results show how temporal graph representation, constrained extraction, and auditable evaluation integrate into a unified framework for verifiable knowledge processing over long-form narrative.
2609.05139.paper_summary_zh: 長篇文學敘事對於增強檢索生成提出了一個獨特的信息處理挑戰：相關證據分佈在各個章節中，關係隨著敘事時間而演變，正確答案可能共同依賴於時間、空間和關係約束。我們提出了NS-ST-GraphRAG，一個神經符號時空GraphRAG框架，該框架整合了本體引導的提取、確定性約束檢查、雙重時間坐標、空間場景屬性和動態子圖檢索。該框架不是從單一的語料庫級圖中檢索，而是選擇對查詢的時間和空間範圍有效的圖狀態，並在可追溯的證據中基於生成的答案。我們進一步介紹了Red-Chamber-QA，據我們所知，這是首個針對古典中文文學的開放式多跳問題回答基準，包含時間、空間和一般問題類別、每部分證據跨度以及確定性捷徑控制。在一個包含120個問題的保留分割中，NS-ST-GraphRAG達到了0.733的機械答案再現率，而凍結窗口基線為0.675，閉卷模型為0.083（McNemar精確p = 0.092，方向上有利但不顯著）；語義評判準確率為0.866對比0.850。H2的預先指定約束類別條件不被所提供的比較所支持。這些結果顯示了時間圖表示、約束提取和可審計評估如何整合成一個統一的框架，以實現長篇敘事的可驗證知識處理。
2609.05139.author: Zheng Kui Lin et.al.
